# v2 optimisation log (generated by `scripts/optimize_v2.py report` — do not edit by hand)

Every experiment below ran on the **development split**: train 2018–19, validation 2020, dev-test 2021. The 2022 test year is not read by any stage. Raw results: `artifacts/v2/dev/optimization/*.json`.

## 1. Diagnosis (train/validation only)

* Validation bust rate 0.100; low-spread share 0.215; hidden busts are 12.0% of busts.
* Each region is one native 5.625° grid point, so the regional error is |ensemble mean − ERA5| at one point: a very noisy label.
* **Spread-only predictability ceiling.** If the ensemble were perfectly reliable (Gaussian), a spread-only model would reach AUPRC ≈ 0.229 on validation (train 0.212). The analytic reliable-Gaussian probability itself scores 0.181 on the real validation labels; its mean (0.074) is below the observed rate (0.100): the ensemble is under-dispersive against ERA5 at this scale.
* **v1 hyper-parameters on v2 features:** B2 0.1701 (821 trees) vs ALL 0.1728 (57 trees); Spearman rank correlation of their predictions 0.878; spread features carry 42% of ALL's gain.
* **Consequence for B2 (spec: do not weaken B2).** The analytic spread probability beat the tree B2, so B2 received the spread-only input `spread_thr_ratio` (spread / TRAIN bust threshold in metres).

## 2. Hyper-parameter search (same grid for B2 and Sentinel)

Stage 1 grid {'max_depth': [2, 3, 5], 'min_child_weight': [50, 300], 'colsample_bytree': [0.5, 1.0]} with {'learning_rate': 0.05, 'subsample': 0.8, 'reg_lambda': 10.0, 'n_estimators': 3000}; stage 2 (refine) at depth 3, learning rate 0.02 over {'colsample_bytree': [0.3, 0.5], 'min_child_weight': [300, 1500], 'reg_lambda': [10.0, 100.0]}. Early stopping on validation AUPRC. Class weighting (scale_pos_weight 3, 9) tested on each best configuration.

| Model | Runs | Best validation AUPRC | Best configuration (depth / min_child_weight / colsample / λ / lr) |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| B2 | 20 | 0.1766 | 3 / 50 / 0.5 / 10.0 / 0.05 |
| B2_v1inputs | 12 | 0.1707 | 5 / 300 / 0.5 / 10.0 / 0.05 |
| ALL | 20 | 0.1816 | 3 / 50 / 0.5 / 10.0 / 0.05 |
| ALL@residual_b2 | 20 | 0.1792 | 5 / 50 / 0.5 / 10.0 / 0.05 |

Class weighting: B2+spw3 0.1764; B2+spw9 0.1759; ALL+spw3 0.1808; ALL+spw9 0.1799; ALL@residual_b2+spw3 0.1775; ALL@residual_b2+spw9 0.1768 (all below the unweighted optimum, rejected).
Seed stability of the optima (seeds 1–3): B2 0.1766, 0.1752, 0.1757; ALL 0.1795, 0.1785, 0.1808; ALL@residual_b2 0.1768, 0.1781, 0.1778

## 4. One dev-test check (2021) of the validation-selected configuration

Selection ATM, EVO, MEM, REC, DYN: B2 AUPRC 0.1578, Sentinel 0.1569 (-0.6%), 95% CI of the difference [-0.0038, 0.0019]. **The validation gain did not transfer.**

## 6. Locked configuration (config/model_v2.yaml)

* Learner: standard — learner with the higher best validation AUPRC on the ALL feature set (standard 0.1816 vs residual_b2 0.1792).
* B2 and Sentinel hyper-parameters: {'learning_rate': 0.05, 'subsample': 0.8, 'reg_lambda': 10.0, 'n_estimators': 3000, 'max_depth': 3, 'min_child_weight': 50, 'colsample_bytree': 0.5} (highest validation-2020 AUPRC over the stage-1 grid (12 configs) + stage-2 refinement (8 configs), same grid for B2 and Sentinel; class weighting (scale_pos_weight 3, 9) tested and rejected).
* Sentinel groups: ATM, EVO, MEM, REC (two-period rule; the wind/MSLP DYN group was rejected because its 2020 gain reversed in 2021).
